Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_CapMinutes_toolt: How many real minutes each account may spend connected in one week. 600 is ten hours.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_ResetDay_tooltip: Every account's minutes go back to zero at 00:00, in the night between the day before and this one. Change this setting and the counters as they stand are reset at once, without waiting for that day to come round.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_WarnMinutes_tool: Minutes of play left, separated by semicolons, at which a player is warned so they can get ready. Each one is said once per session. Empty means no warning until their time is up.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_ExemptRoles_tool: Role names separated by semicolons. Accounts holding one of these roles are never turned out. Empty means nobody is exempt, administrators included.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_BlockedMessage: Extra message on being turned out
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_BlockedMessage_t: Leave this empty and the mod says it in each player's own language. Write something and every player reads exactly that instead. It cannot contain a comma. Either way the numbers follow underneath.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_GraceSeconds_too: How long a refused player gets to read why before their game disconnects itself.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_timeUp: Your time for this week is up.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_used: You have used %1 of your %2 minutes this week.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_warning: %1 minutes of play left this week.
Sandbox_MaxTimeInServer_played: You have played %1 minutes this week (limit %2).
